title: Inventory Reorder Alerts
summary: A Google Sheet that knows when each product will run out and emails purchasing before it happens.
result: Stock-outs caught 1–3 weeks early, with a suggested order quantity for every product.

metric.label: of sales covered by each suggested reorder

note: Demo built with fictitious store data.

screenshots.alt: Stock sheet: days of cover, reorder point, suggested order and status per SKU
Daily alert email listing products to reorder now and this week

upworkBlurb: Inventory reorder system in Google Sheets + Apps Script for a small online store. It imports daily sales, calculates days of stock left, reorder points from supplier lead times and a suggested order quantity per product, and colour-codes every SKU (OK / reorder soon / reorder now). Every morning a script emails purchasing the products that will run out before a new order can arrive. No paid apps. Demo uses fictitious data. Stack: Google Sheets, Apps Script, Gmail.
